subject: Re: CISC kickoff — cheaper self-consistency for reasoning endpoints
body:
Decision checkpoint.

Offline A/B confirmed Katya's numbers: 36% serving-cost reduction at neutral-to-positive accuracy on logged reasoning traffic. We go to shadow deployment.

Jorge's serving integration with Shipyard is on track — confidence-weighted vote runs in the aggregation layer, no model changes needed, and Zeke's team signed off on the latency budget (adds <8ms p99). Shadow deploy targets May 27, two weeks of shadow, then launch review June 8 — Nadia has us penciled for that board.

One scope decision: we ship with verbalized confidence only. Umar's alternative confidence heads go to a fast-follow; the shrunken-but-solid 36% is worth banking now rather than chasing the last few points into Q3.

Priya
